testcase.name: Scenario: Open the file menu while a part is active: tmp/oblikovati-bdd-LkzC5t/checkout/features/application/file-menu/file-menu.feature:4:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Open the file menu while a part is active ✔ Given a part document is active in the MCAD Software ✔ When the user selects File ✔ Then a menu opens with New, Open, Save, Save As, Export, Print and Close entries ✔ And the menu also shows Share, Manage and document properties entries ✔ And the command entries form a vertical list on the left ✔ And a recent-documents region is visible to the right of that list ✔ And some commands show disclosure indicators ✔ And application options and an exit control appear at the bottom of the menu ✔ And the model workspace remains visible behind the menu

testcase.name: Scenario: Dismiss the file menu with Escape: tmp/oblikovati-bdd-LkzC5t/checkout/features/application/file-menu/file-menu.feature:15:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Dismiss the file menu with Escape ✔ Given a part document is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the File menu is open ✔ When the user presses Escape ✔ Then the File menu and recent-documents region close ✔ And the same part document remains active

testcase.name: Scenario: Dismiss the file menu by clicking outside: tmp/oblikovati-bdd-LkzC5t/checkout/features/application/file-menu/file-menu.feature:22:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Dismiss the file menu by clicking outside ✔ Given an empty part document is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the File menu is open ✔ When the user clicks an empty area of the viewport outside the menu ✔ Then the File menu and recent-documents region close ✔ And the same part document remains active

testcase.name: Scenario: Open and dismiss the file menu in a drawing: tmp/oblikovati-bdd-LkzC5t/checkout/features/application/file-menu/file-menu.feature:29:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Open and dismiss the file menu in a drawing ✔ Given a drawing document is active in the MCAD Software ✔ When the user selects File ✔ Then the menu shows New, Open, Save, Save As, Export, Share, Manage, document properties, Print and Close entries ✔ And a recent-documents region is visible ✔ And the drawing sheet remains visible around the menu ✔ When the user presses Escape ✔ Then the File menu closes ✔ And the same drawing document remains active

testcase.name: Scenario: Inspect controls in the recent-documents region: tmp/oblikovati-bdd-LkzC5t/checkout/features/application/file-menu/file-menu.feature:39:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Inspect controls in the recent-documents region ✔ Given a part document is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And recent documents are available ✔ When the user selects File ✔ Then the recent-documents region shows an ordering control labeled By Ordered List ✔ And a separate display control is visible beside it ✔ And each visible recent-document row shows a document-type symbol and name on the left ✔ And each visible row shows a pin control on the right ✔ And the active part remains visible around the menu ✔ When the user presses Escape ✔ Then the menu closes and the same part remains active

testcase.name: Scenario: Inspect the Save As submenu for a saved part: tmp/oblikovati-bdd-LkzC5t/checkout/features/application/file-menu/file-menu.feature:52:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Inspect the Save As submenu for a saved part ✔ Given a saved part is active in the MCAD Software ✔ When the user selects File ✔ And the user expands Save As ✔ Then the submenu offers Save As and Save Copy As ✔ And it offers Save Copy As Template and Pack and Go ✔ And the Save Copy As description says the original file remains open

testcase.name: Scenario: Open the New submenu from the File menu: tmp/oblikovati-bdd-LkzC5t/checkout/features/application/file-menu/file-menu.feature:60:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Open the New submenu from the File menu ✔ Given a part document is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the pointer is positioned over the New command location ✔ When the user presses Alt+F to open the File menu ✔ Then the New submenu is displayed ✔ And the submenu describes creating a file from the available templates ✔ And it lists Assembly, Weldment, Drawing, Part, Sheet Metal and Presentation ✔ And Drawing displays a disclosure indicator ✔ And the active part remains visible behind the menu ✔ And no document type has been activated

testcase.name: Scenario: Inspect the File menu from Home: tmp/oblikovati-bdd-LkzC5t/checkout/features/application/file-menu/file-menu.feature:72:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Inspect the File menu from Home ✔ Given Home is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And recent documents are available ✔ When the user selects File ✔ Then a vertical list of file commands opens over Home ✔ And a recent-documents region is shown beside the command list ✔ And Save As, document properties and Print appear muted ✔ And the Home recent-documents view remains visible around the menu
